summary: Frontend-only validation of Android PDF sharing fix performed with web regression, static code review, dependency verification, and build/lint checks. Web export still works with 2 stories and summary message; Android-native share path cannot be device-validated in this environment.

integration_issues.issue: `yarn expo export --platform android` failed in environment: Hermes compiler binary execution error (`hermesc: Syntax error: word unexpected`). Android bundle compile could not be confirmed here.

action_items: Validate Android native sharing on real device/emulator (Expo Go/dev build): ensure share sheet opens and no 'Not allowed to read file under given URL'.
Investigate CI/container Hermes toolchain issue blocking `expo export --platform android`.
Address blocking lint errors before considering this branch lint-clean (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`, `react-hooks/refs`).
critical_code_review_comments: Non-web branch correctly uses `Print.printToFileAsync({ html })` then `preparePdfForSharing(uri)` then `Sharing.shareAsync(shareableUri, ...)`; original print URI is not passed to share.
`preparePdfForSharing` enforces `file://`, copies to `FileSystem.cacheDirectory` with `.pdf` filename, then validates `exists` + non-zero `size`.
Android options are present (`mimeType: application/pdf`, `dialogTitle`), and iOS-only `UTI: com.adobe.pdf` is conditionally applied.
Web regression path remains isolated (`Platform.OS === 'web'`): popup print flow and `book-export-summary` succeed without hitting mobile sharing path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login with verification@racontelle.fr succeeded; mobile-web viewport test reached Livre romancé with exactly 2 chapter cards; clicking `book-export-pdf` showed `PDF prêt : 2 histoires incluses.`. Static checks confirm share URI copy strategy and platform-specific options. Remaining gap is native Android device/emulator validation and Hermes export environment failure.
rca_of_issue: Target Android bug root cause appears addressed in code by copying expo-print output to cache .pdf before share. Unresolved risk is unverified runtime behavior on real Android due unavailable native execution path in this run; separate environment/toolchain issue blocked Android export bundle verification.
